meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上这个技能后,Claude 会持续盯住一个 Pull Request 直到它真正可合并:反复查看评论、评审和 CI 结果,发现真问题就修改代码并推送,直到所有检查通过、没有未解决的评审线程才停止。
howto.when: 当你明确要求它 babysit、monitor(照看/监控)某个 PR,或要求它持续检查 PR 的评论、评审和 CI,直到所有可处理的问题都被解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我 babysit 一下 PR #123，直到可以合并
say.note: Claude 会持续监控该 PR 并处理问题

say.text: 持续检查 #42 的评审和 CI，有未解决的问题就修
盯着 review 线程，全部解决后告诉我
say.note: 它会等待所有线程关闭

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude stays with a pull request until it is actually mergeable: it repeatedly checks comments, reviews, and CI, fixes real issues in commits, and only stops when checks pass and no unresolved review threads remain.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask it to babysit or monitor a PR, or to keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until it's ready to merge.
say_en.note: Claude will monitor and fix issues.

say_en.text: Keep checking reviews and CI on #42; fix anything unresolved.
say_en.note: It will poll and resolve issues.

say_en.text: Watch the review threads and tell me when all are resolved.
say_en.note: It will wait until all threads are closed.
